scope: Isolated synthetic controller and GPUI fixture; no real download, install, external link, user configuration, or production process modified.
initial_findings: Buttons along bottom of 620x560 dialog had their bottom border and rounded corners clipped.
AX dialog exposed buttons but not visible title, version, date and body.
After scrolling the body, switching to Ready retained the scroll offset and hid the Ready headline.

final_retest.available: Centered approximately 620x560; release name, current and new versions, date, body, and three buttons visible. Bottom borders and corners are complete at both window sizes.
final_retest.accessibility: AX exposes dialog title, version, date, paragraphs and expanded log entries. Tab and Shift+Tab visibly move focus; Enter activates the focused close control; Escape closes the dismissible dialog. AX reported focused UI element as window during the visible focus checks; screen reader was not enabled or tested.
final_retest.scroll: Long body and timestamped logs scroll inside dialog; Available scrolled to bottom then Ready resets to top and shows the full Ready headline.
final_retest.latest: Synthetic latest shows current and latest v0.6.0 and completion button; sample fixture logs are static and not evidence of actual latest-check logging.
final_retest.error: Synthetic HTTP 403 shows the error, timestamped log and retry button; retry returned to checking then the same synthetic error.
final_retest.close_icon: Visible and clickable; exact 13.7-point glyph measurement not independently verified from screenshots.

initial_fixture_behavior: Synthetic download displayed 42% and 42.0/100.0 MiB; cancel returned cancelled state.
Synthetic Ready to Waiting via install, then Later closed dialog and controller phase returned Ready.
Synthetic Installing disabled close, cancel and main action; clicking them and Escape did not dismiss dialog.
limitations: Only macOS synthetic controller path tested; no real package download, installation, rollback, external browser or restart.
No VoiceOver or physical screen-reader validation.
Figma comparison was against the supplied design criteria; no independent Figma node inspection in this subtask.
